feedback.problem:
Suppose that $|\,c\,|=8$, $|\,d\,|=5$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta ={45}^{∘}.$ Find the vector projection of $c$ onto $d$ in terms of the vector $d.$

${\text{proj}}_{d}\,c=$
{{field-1}}
$d$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{d}\,c & =|\,c\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡({45}^{∘}) \\  & =8\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\  & =4\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $d:$

$$
u=\frac{d}{|\,d\,|}=\frac{d}{5}=\frac{1}{5}d
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{d}\,c & ={\text{comp}}_{d}\,c\cdot u \\  & =4\sqrt{2}\cdot \frac{1}{5}d \\  & =\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}\,d\end{aligned}
$$
